BitLife 77 DMCA Copyright Policy

BitLife 77 (https://bitlife-77.github.io/) respects the intellectual property rights of others and adheres strictly to the provisions of the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (17 U.S.C. § 512, “DMCA”).

Copyright Ownership

BitLife 77 operates as an indexing portal for browser-based HTML5 games. We do not claim ownership of the third-party games hosted or linked on this site; all titles, characters, and assets belong to their respective copyright holders. If you believe your copyrighted work has been displayed on BitLife 77 without authorization, we will respond promptly to valid takedown notices.

Filing a DMCA Notice

To submit a copyright infringement notification, please send a written request to our designated agent at admin@bitlife-77.github.io containing the following information:

  1. Identification of the Copyrighted Work: A description or link to the copyrighted work claimed to have been infringed.
  2. Location of Infringing Content: The exact URL on BitLife 77 where the material is located (for example, https://bitlife-77.github.io/game/example-title.html).
  3. Your Contact Information: Your full legal name, company or organization, physical address, telephone number, and official email address.
  4. Good Faith Statement: A statement that you have a good-faith belief that the disputed use of the material is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.
  5. Accuracy Statement: A statement made under penalty of perjury that the information in your notification is accurate and that you are the copyright owner or authorized to act on the owner’s behalf.
  6. Signature: A physical or electronic signature of the copyright owner or authorized representative.

Takedown Action

Upon receipt of a valid and complete DMCA notice, BitLife 77 will remove or disable access to the infringing content within 24 to 48 business hours.
